2014_spells.skywrite.description: You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see. The words look like clouds and remain in place for the spell's duration.
2014_spells.skywrite.effectSummary: Change a target: cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see
2014_spells.skywrite.fullDescription: Using 1 action, the words look like clouds and remain in place for the spell's duration. You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 1 hour; you can cast it as a ritual.
